pairing: same permutation across both orientations and ordinary/forced modes within each replica; distinct seed domains across N
forced_face: cyclic site labels {0,a,b,(a+b) mod N}; occupy all four, then activate remaining sites in induced permutation order
inference: paired delete-one-batch root/slope-complete jackknife within N; independent covariance groups across N; all baselines from these fresh ordinary streams

stop_material_route: if all four simultaneous intervals lie inside [-0.5,0.5], stop prioritizing this source as a main coupling at this declared finite-scale resolution
material_coordinate: a simultaneous interval wholly above +0.5 or below -0.5 resolves a material response in these declared units
sign_prediction: none; the exact decimation map forces a term but not its sign
unresolved_action: publish unresolved result and stop this fixed block; no sample top-up, no source or size substitution
